title: Tech View opens on 13 default columns with small grey header labels
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run). You have never changed Tech View's columns.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-04-tech-view-header-row-1440.png" and "DC-04-tech-view-all-columns-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and the rank numbers in the pictures are sample data. Your screen lets you widen the window to 1536 px.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C590113 Columns" has an Approved work order, unit "C590113-U1", led by technician "ZZAUTOTEST C590113 Ana".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C590113 Columns", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the column header labels from left to right, scrolling the table sideways to see them all.
  2. Compare the size, weight and colour of the header labels with the row text under them and with the design picture.
  3. Look at the space between each pair of neighbouring header labels.
  4. Click the "Column Selection" button.
  5. Turn on "On Site", "VIN/Serial #", "Lead Technician" and every other column the list offers that is off.
  6. Press Escape.
  7. Scroll the table sideways from left to right and look at every header label.
  8. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  9. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  10. Widen the window to 1536 px.
custom_expected:
Step 1: 13 columns, in this order: "Status", "Waiting On Parts", "Number", "Customer", "Unit", "Asset", "Progress", "Service Advisor", "Clocked In", "Lines", "Assigned Techs", "Created on", "Total price". "On Site", "VIN/Serial #" and "Lead Technician" are not shown.

Step 2: the header labels are small (12 px in the design, smaller than the 14 px row text), medium weight (not bold) and grey (lighter than the row text), as in the picture.

Step 3: no header label touches or overlaps its neighbour.

Step 4: the column list opens and offers "On Site", "VIN/Serial #" and "Lead Technician".

Step 5: each one turned on shows as a column.

Step 6: the column list closes.

Step 7: with every column on, no header label touches, overlaps or is cut off by its neighbour, as in the all-columns picture.

Step 8: the header labels keep the same size, weight and grey colour at Compact.

Step 9: the header labels keep the same size, weight and grey colour at Comfortable.

Step 10: at 1536 px no header label touches or overlaps its neighbour.

AUTOMATION: READY
